description: Source of truth for /nest-init. Each entry is an opt-in, reusable agent config. `scope` = where it installs (project = the current repo's .claude; global = ~/.claude). `recommendWhen` lets /nest-init pre-check relevant items after sniffing the project.

entries.title: Session context wrap-up protocol
entries.summary: CLAUDE.md protocol: work in atomic build-passing units, checkpoint each, and hand off remaining scope to a roadmap item when the context window fills.
install: Append the body of configs/rules/session-wrap-up.md into the project's CLAUDE.md (create CLAUDE.md if absent).
entries.recommendWhen: Project has a build + commit workflow and sessions get long.

entries.title: Context-budget wrap-up guard (hook)
entries.summary: PostToolUse hook that watches context-window occupancy and injects a wrap-up nudge at soft/hard thresholds. Zero model tokens.
install: Merge the context-guard PostToolUse entry from configs/hooks/settings.hooks.json into <project>/.claude/settings.local.json, replacing the command path with the real absolute path to the copied hook.
entries.recommendWhen: Always useful; strongest when paired with session-wrap-up.

entries.title: Memory review after commit (hook)
entries.summary: PostToolUse (Bash) hook: after any `git commit`, nudges the agent to review the session and update auto-memory.
install: Merge the memory-review-after-commit PostToolUse entry from configs/hooks/settings.hooks.json into <project>/.claude/settings.local.json.
entries.recommendWhen: Project is a git repo and you use the auto-memory protocol.

entries.title: Roadmap command + docs/roadmap convention
entries.summary: /roadmap slash command that lists kickoff-ready task briefs with stable, deterministic IDs (one markdown file per task under docs/roadmap/).
install: Create the docs/roadmap/ directory (this is where task briefs live).
entries.recommendWhen: Any project that accrues future-work briefs / needs clean session handoffs.

entries.title: Auto-memory protocol
entries.summary: File-based persistent memory kept outside the repo (~/.claude/projects/<slug>/memory/): one fact per file + a MEMORY.md index. Conventions for what to save and how.
install: This is a convention, not a copied file. Review configs/memory/README.md and follow it; the memory files are created on demand by the harness.
entries.recommendWhen: Any ongoing project where cross-session recall pays off.

entries.title: Safe permission allowlist
entries.summary: Pre-allow low-risk, frequently-approved commands (e.g. `npm run *`) so the agent isn't prompted repeatedly.
install: Optionally run /fewer-permission-prompts later to grow the list from your own transcripts.
entries.recommendWhen: Node/npm projects. Adapt the globs for other stacks.

entries.title: Global agent settings (model / effort / notifications)
entries.summary: ~/.claude/settings.json preferences: model=opus, effortLevel=xhigh, push notifications on background-agent completion.
install: Merge the keys from configs/settings/global-settings.json into ~/.claude/settings.json.
entries.recommendWhen: Set once per machine (global). Skip if already configured to taste.

entries.title: Playwright MCP server
entries.summary: Browser automation + screenshots; powers the visual-iteration workflow. No secrets.
install: Add the playwright server block from configs/mcp/playwright.md to <project>/.mcp.json, pointing --output-dir at a folder in this project.
entries.recommendWhen: Web / UI projects, or anything with visual output to iterate on.

entries.title: Supabase MCP server
entries.summary: Inspect/query a Supabase project (tables, migrations, logs, advisors) from the agent.
install: Add the supabase server block from configs/mcp/supabase.md to <project>/.mcp.json.
Provide a real sbp_ access token (never commit it — gitignore .mcp.json or inject from env).

entries.title: Visual iteration workflow
entries.summary: Serve scratch HTML/SVG over HTTP (Playwright MCP blocks file://), take element screenshots to iterate, clean up scratch PNGs after.
install: Append the body of configs/rules/visual-iteration.md into the project's CLAUDE.md.
entries.recommendWhen: Projects with hand-tuned visuals (SVG, charts, custom components).

entries.title: Direct-to-main push + auto-checkpoint
entries.summary: Push straight to main and auto commit+push finished, build-passing units without being asked. Opt-in per repo.
install: Append the body of configs/rules/direct-push.md into the project's CLAUDE.md — ONLY for solo/trunk-based repos.
entries.recommendWhen: Solo repos without PR review or protected branches. Confirm first.

entries.title: Build (not just typecheck) before pushing
entries.summary: Run the full build the deploy runs (not just a typecheck) before committing/pushing.
install: Append the body of configs/rules/build-before-push.md into the project's CLAUDE.md.
entries.recommendWhen: Any project with a build/compile step that CI or the host runs.
